rule: This registry mirrors documented decisions and gates; it cannot resolve canonical decisions.

decisions.title: Commercial Event to Commercial State transition table
decisions.current_guardrail: Keep the lead state graph as an interim hypothesis; reject transitions outside its documented boundary.

decisions.title: Commercial Event scope
decisions.current_guardrail: Do not generalize inferred CommercialEvent semantics to observed, claimed, imported or operational assertions without an RFC.

decisions.title: Attribution model choice
decisions.current_guardrail: Keep attribution UNKNOWN; do not infer revenue credit from source or conversation identity.

decisions.title: Identity merge thresholds and undo mechanics
decisions.current_guardrail: No automatic merge; Customer and Lead remain distinct and reversible evidence-backed linkage is required.

decisions.title: External CRM field and schema mapping
decisions.current_guardrail: CRM adapters cannot own canonical commercial semantics; no production mapping is assumed.

decisions.title: Detailed permissions and credential model
decisions.current_guardrail: Enforce only the frozen lead-scoped boundary; do not expand manager, support or mutation privileges.

decisions.title: North Star vision versus current LVP scope
decisions.current_guardrail: Keep the five-engine vision separate from the narrow manual/synthetic LVP until a phase gate broadens scope.
